components.name: TutorialActions
components.description: Coach-mark gestures drawn over the page, in one thin-line style: taps, double-taps, long-presses, right-clicks, hovers, swipes, scrolls, pinches, spreads, rotations, pulls, drags, marquee selections and keyboard shortcuts. Targets are followed as the page scrolls and resizes (or every frame with `track="frame"`), and the overlay never takes pointer input. Reduced motion holds each gesture in a still pose.

props.name: gesture
props.description: The action to show. Point gestures (tap, double-tap, long-press, context, hover, swipe, scroll, pinch, spread, rotate, pull, keys) sit on `target`; marquee outlines it; drag runs from `from` to `to`.

props.name: from
props.description: Where the drag starts. The path leaves from the edge facing `to`.

props.name: at
props.description: Where on `target` the gesture sits, as fractions of its box. Default the middle.

props.name: device
props.description: Mouse pointer or finger. auto picks by the device's pointer. Touch-only and mouse-only gestures ignore it.

props.name: direction
props.description: Read by swipe and scroll only. swipe: which way the finger moves. Default left. scroll: which way you scroll through the page. The view moves that way, so the finger and the content move the other way. Default down.

props.name: clockwise
props.description: Which way rotate turns. Default true.

props.name: track
props.description: layout re-places the guide when the page scrolls or resizes, when the target resizes, and on a slow check (400ms). frame follows the target every frame, for targets that move on their own. Drags always run every frame, since the drag itself is animated there.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far swipes, scrolls, pulls and two-finger gestures travel, in px.

props.name: keys
props.description: Keycaps. For keys, the shortcut: every key held, the last one tapped. For any other gesture, modifiers held down while it plays (Shift-click, Alt-drag).

props.name: curl
props.description: How far the drag path bends to one side, -1 to 1. 0 is straight.

props.name: path
props.description: Draw the drag path as marching dashes under the gliding arrow.

props.name: trail
props.description: Copies trailing the gliding arrowhead. 0 shows the head alone.

props.name: hand
props.description: The device's hand carries the drag at the head of the trail, instead of a lone arrowhead.

props.name: duration
props.description: One loop of the gesture, in ms. Each gesture has its own default.

props.name: land
props.description: Where the drag lands: the middle of `to`, or its edge facing `from`.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the guide without unmounting it.
